description.zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支。
description.en: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

description.zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID。
description.en: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the main branch.

description.zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a main branch. When you create a child branch, the region is inherited from the main branch by default.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于将子分支重置为父分支的最新数据。主分支、无父分支的分支、有子分支的分支和受保护分支不支持重置。
descriptions.en: Resets a child branch to the latest data of its parent branch. The main branch, branches without a parent branch, branches with child branches, and protected branches cannot be reset.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb reset-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --branch-id br-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
